note: The committed census at launch_packages/pettripfinder/identity_census/detroit-ann-arbor-mi.json is UNCHANGED and remains the market's authority. This reconciles it against a shadow projection built from a local OSM extract at zero cost. Every one of the 182 committed identities is accounted for by name: carried forward, carried through an explicit absorption, or HELD with a stated reason. None disappeared.

defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.summary: Absorption lets a THINNER discovery record overwrite a committed row's populated locality fields -- state, and city.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.evidence: 'The Bell Tower Hotel' is committed with city='Ann Arbor', state='MI'; its recandidated row reads state=None. 'Crowne Plaza Auburn Hills' is committed with city='Auburn Hills', state='MI', postal='48326'; it was absorbed into an OSM sighting whose city is empty, and the merged candidate kept the EMPTY city, so it was held IDENTITY_NO_LOCALITY -- 'the candidate states no city' -- about a property whose committed row names its city plainly.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.consequence: 7 committed identities were held IDENTITY_NO_LOCALITY and 3 more were absorbed into targets that were then held. None was lost, because the pipeline holds rather than drops -- but a promotion built on this shadow would strand 10 good committed rows. This is generic and would affect every market's recensus, not only Detroit.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.not_fixed_here: Out of scope for this order, which syncs generic modules unchanged rather than editing them. Fixing it is the first item of the next order.

defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.summary: Absorption lets a thin discovery name OVERWRITE a committed canonical name.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.evidence: 'Best Western Greenfield Inn' -- IDENTITY_CONFIRMED, routed, the market's only explicit corridor assignment -- was absorbed by street identity into an OSM row named merely 'Best Western'. 70 of the 103 absorptions renamed a committed identity this way, including 'Daxton Hotel' -> 'Daxon Hotel' (an OSM misspelling) and 'Comfort Inn Metro Airport' -> 'Comfort Inn Hotel'.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.consequence: A promotion built on this shadow would silently downgrade committed canonical names to whatever OSM happens to call the building. A census promotion must SUPERSEDE a prior identity, never overwrite it.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.not_fixed_here: Reported, not fixed. Blocks promotion of this shadow census.

defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.summary: OSM spells one municipality 'Farmington Hill' (singular), which is not the registered 'Farmington Hills'.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.evidence: The absorption target for 'Delta Hotels by Marriott Detroit Novi' carries city='Farmington Hill', postal 48335, and was held MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED as BORDERLINE.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.consequence: A false UNRESOLVED caused by upstream spelling, not by a real boundary question. Worth an alias, never a silent string fix.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.not_fixed_here: Reported. Belongs in the boundary packet as an alias question.

defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.severity: INFORMATIONAL -- a finding, not a defect
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.summary: The shadow run independently RESOLVED one of Detroit's two IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL holds.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.evidence: 'Courtyard by Marriott Detroit Novi' (IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL, no official_url, no route, 42700 W 11 Mile Rd 48375) was absorbed by street identity into the OSM sighting behind 'Sonesta Select Detroit Novi' (committed separately at 42700 West 11 Mile Rd 48375, with a live sonesta.com property URL). Same building, same ZIP, same street.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.consequence: The Courtyard row is a stale pre-rebrand identity of the Sonesta Select row, not a missing hotel. That is a founder identity ruling -- CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE / renamed in place -- and it is NOT made here. It would take Detroit's open identity holds from 2 to 1 at zero cost.
defects_found_in_the_generic_pipeline.not_fixed_here: Reported for founder ruling in the next order.
